details.title: Market details
details.same_limits: Same limits as Plan check: 10 % watch, 50 % too big.

notes.prices: Spread % is the gap between ask and bid, relative to the ask. “vs Universe 7D” compares each exchange with the Universe VWAP of all four.
notes.book: Units waiting in each order book right now. Offered = sell orders (what a buyer can take), wanted = buy orders (what a seller can fill).
notes.volume: Units traded. Opened from a plan, two more columns show the plan’s share.
notes.volume_plan: Plan share = what is bought or sold in the period, against what the exchange traded in it.

breadth.label: Breadth
breadth.text: Exchanges whose 7D VWAP is above their 30D VWAP. All of them moving together is a real trend; one alone is often a blip on that exchange.

trend.label: Volume-weighted trend
trend.text: Each exchange’s change counted by how much it traded in 7 days, so a big exchange matters more than a quiet one.

balance.label: Order book balance
balance.buyers: More is offered than wanted: good for buyers, sellers compete for few bids.
balance.sellers: More is wanted than offered: good for sellers, buyers compete for few offers.
balance.even: Offers and bids are about even.

cohesion.label: Price cohesion
cohesion.text: How far the four 7D VWAPs spread around their mean. Under 1.5 % they move in lock-step; over 5 % the gaps can pay for shipping between exchanges.
